record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.context_brief: Smooth strictly convex AdS boundary metrics
record.original_question: Let S be a closed surface of genus at least 2, and let h_- and h_+ be two metrics on S with curvature strictly less than -1 everywhere. Is there a unique anti-de Sitter 3-manifold N with smooth, space-like, strictly convex boundary such that the induced metrics on the two connected components of ∂N are h_- and h_+, respectively?

evidence.quote: Question 3.5. Let h−, h+ be two metrics on S with curvature κ < −1. Is there a unique AdS manifold N with smooth, space-like, strictly convex boundary such that the induced metrics on the two connected components of ∂N are equal respectively to h− and h+?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a closed orientable surface of genus at least $2$, and let $h_-$ and $h_+$ be two smooth Riemannian metrics on $S$ each having Gaussian curvature strictly less than $-1$ at every point.

An anti-de Sitter (AdS) $3$-manifold is a Lorentzian $3$-manifold of constant sectional curvature $-1$. Consider compact AdS $3$-manifolds $N$ diffeomorphic to $S \times [0,1]$ whose boundary $\partial N$ has two connected components, each of which is a smooth, space-like, strictly convex surface (where strict convexity means the second fundamental form is positive definite with respect to the inward-pointing normal).

Question: Does there exist a unique such AdS $3$-manifold $N$ (up to isometry isotopic to the identity) for which the induced metrics on the two boundary components are isometric to $h_-$ and $h_+$, respectively?
artifact.status_search_result: The general existence-and-uniqueness question appears still open. Recent work by Prosanov and Schlenker (arXiv:2502.01599, JLMS 2026) establishes infinitesimal rigidity (a local uniqueness statement) for globally hyperbolic compact AdS (2+1)-spacetimes with smooth strictly convex spacelike boundary whose holonomy lies near the Fuchsian locus, and Chen–Schlenker (arXiv:2405.01912) handles existence/uniqueness of one prescribed induced metric on a single convex Cauchy surface in quasifuchsian AdS spacetimes. A complete resolution for arbitrary pairs $(h_-, h_+)$ of metrics with curvature $<-1$ has not been reported.

status_evidence.title: Rigidity of anti-de Sitter (2+1)-spacetimes with convex boundary near the Fuchsian locus
status_evidence.snippet: Globally hyperbolic compact AdS (2+1)-spacetimes with strictly convex spacelike boundary (smooth or polyhedral) whose holonomy is close to Fuchsian are determined by the induced metric on the boundary.
status_evidence.claim: Provides infinitesimal/local rigidity (uniqueness near Fuchsian locus) but not the full global result.

status_evidence.title: Convex surfaces with prescribed induced metrics in anti-de Sitter spacetimes
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and uniqueness of a quasifuchsian AdS spacetime containing a past-convex (or future-convex) Cauchy surface with prescribed induced metric of curvature < -1.
status_evidence.claim: Handles a single prescribed induced metric, not a pair on two boundary components.

status_evidence.title: Prescribing metrics on the boundary of convex cores of globally hyperbolic maximal compact AdS 3-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Any pair of hyperbolic metrics on a closed surface of genus > 1 can be realized as induced metrics on the two boundary components of the convex core of a maximal globally hyperbolic AdS 3-manifold.
status_evidence.claim: Resolves an analogous prescription problem for the (non-smooth) convex core, related but distinct from the smooth strictly convex boundary version.
